name: Jalingo

routes.outcome: Official TAGIS site identifies Taraba Geographic Information Service in Jalingo and describes digital land administration, cadastral mapping, land registration, surveying, and GIS services.
TAGIS service page describes the state land-information system and land administration/registration procedures; it is custodian evidence, not an exposed parcel API.
Official Taraba State contact directory lists Taraba Geographic Information Service, P.M.B. 1105, Donga Road, Jalingo, as a state government focal agency.
Public API route redirected to login.php and set a PHP session; no login was attempted and no private/authenticated endpoint was pursued.
Public sign-in page reached; it is a login wall. No credentials were used.
Public downloads page exposed general PDFs and map/document references, but no public parcel GeoJSON, WFS, ArcGIS REST, or safe parcel-ID-plus-geometry response.

Public application-tracking page exposes a property-processing workflow that posts to process_property.php; it concerns submitted applications and was not queried for personal, title, owner, or parcel records.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: No anonymous parcel geometry request was available without authentication.

polygon geometry if later exposed anonymously

qualification.reason: Local cadastral custodian is evidenced, but no safe anonymous parcel schema or geometry response was exposed. Adapter qualification remains a separate serial review.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point was preserved and no coordinate shift or parcel-hit forcing was attempted.
A login wall, absent public API, or lack of an exact-point hit is not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
TAGIS is a local/state custodian; national/general agency search context was not treated as a local parcel service.
No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe anonymous native ID-plus-geometry response was available.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, certificate/title, or personal fields were requested or retained.
Raw request/page captures remain under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/jalingo/.
uncertainty: TAGIS publicly claims cadastral and digital land services for Taraba and is listed by the state government in Jalingo. The public API path and application portal require sign-in or provide workflow pages only; public coverage, schema, CRS, update cadence, licensing, and runtime adapter behavior remain unverified.
